reviewContext.note: No manifest.json present under .vcsdd/features/EARN-1/reviews/**/input/. Reviewed from the file list + dimensions supplied in the review request, DISK ONLY, zero builder context.

evidence.description: Daily-unconditional model is correct: cron "23 9 * * *" recurring fires every day (NOT a one-picker) — matches master-spec core principle.
gig has detect instead of a PRODUCER — architecturally correct (gig finds live jobs, does not author content). This sub-point passes.
Build-order #1 requires the loop to 'bid/delivers every day'. The DELIVER step is non-functional (detect-only), so the spec's deliver contract is not met (FIND-001).
Settle/earn oracle is genuinely anti-fake: only EXTERNAL inflows counted, self-transfers sum to 0, finalized-head scan, fail-closed cursor. INV-7 holds — verified, not a finding.
representativeExternalTx only attaches a tx for a real Transfer log to the wallet from a non-self payer; returns null otherwise (never fabricates). Verified correct.

Two real bids exist (HTTP 201 + bidId) — the BID side-effect IS verifiable on dealwork.ai. But ts values 'e2e-bid'/'e2e-bid2' show these were MANUAL fires, not produced by the autonomous daily cron (FIND-005).
